notToBeConfusedWith.name: Veal
notToBeConfusedWith.note: A cut from an adult animal, not a calf. Milanesa is traditionally made from beef in Argentina, though veal versions exist elsewhere.

generalSubstitutes.substitute: eye of round or top sirloin
generalSubstitutes.note: Any lean, close-grained roasting cut that slices thinly and pounds out evenly works in its place.

forms.label: Raw
forms.sourceNote: USDA has no record for topside (nalga/bola de lomo) specifically. This is its record for beef top round, separable lean and fat, trimmed to 1/8" fat — the closest lean roasting-cut profile it publishes.
